name: POST /api/admin/voice-agent/calls/:call_id/session-token - One capability token per AI call
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token = ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN, like the other voice-runtime admin routes; the gateway auth gate lets it self-guard). Mints the call's session-scoped capability token (a10e376c-cc5f-4c0d-961c-2db9260a1aa8#AC1 — one capability token per call authorizes all of that call's allowed tools for the call's lifetime). The token covers exactly the tools the call's agent version offers (its enabled tool_ids), may be presented for any of them any number of times, and lives for the voice tier TTL: VOICE_SESSION_TOKEN_TTL_S, capped at 2 h in code and by a DB CHECK. One token per call: calling again returns 200 with the SAME token_id, minted:false and token:null — the bearer string (sct_<token_id>.<64 hex>) is returned ONLY by the mint (201), because only a SHA-256 digest of its secret over the bound fields is stored. reissue:true revokes the live token and mints a new one (for a runtime that lost it). The token is revoked when the call ends (onCallEnded, reason call_ended). No signing key is involved, so key rotation never voids a live call's token. Mint and revoke are audited as agent.capability-token.minted.v1 / .revoked.v1 with scope session. Edge cases: unknown call 404; a call that already ended 409 (no token for an ended call); reissue not a boolean 400; missing/wrong ops token 401/403.

errorCases.message: call is completed; a session token is only issued for a call that has not ended
errorCases.when: the call already ended (completed, failed, refused, deferred)
reissue is present and not a boolean
